metadata.description: Template sensor definitions. Copy and extend for each instrument in your dataset.
notes: identifiers.long_names must match instrument long_name values in NetCDF files
ranges keys must match the units attribute on each data variable
Set requires_instrument to false only for derived variables with no instrument match
